transcript.text: Walk me through a claim that needs prior auth.
If it needs prior auth I put the number in the notes, or sometimes just 'see fax'.
Pretty much every imaging claim for Medicare Advantage needs one.
If I have to open a claim twice, something went wrong.
If coverage changes after the visit, it lands in my queue and I re-run eligibility.
I try to check eligibility again before the claim goes out.
